messages:
neha: FYI - saw a sudden failure surge for southamerica GPU warm-pool nodes. Provisioning stuck due to KMS decrypt denied.
derek: Any change landed? I only saw a small cross-account key-policy update for SA region last night.
neha: That update removed the keystore service principal's sts:AssumeRole binding to the kms-access-role for cross-account decrypts. Keys are still there but our keystore agent can't assume the role to decrypt.
marcos: Log snippet: ```
keystore ERROR: decrypt failed: AccessDenied: not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRole on arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/kms-access-role
agent.join: state=ProvisioningPending attempts=4 reason="IAM assume role denied"
```
ops-bot: change-bot: key-policy PR#452 merged for southamerica (change-id KP-SA-2026-77) at 2026-03-26T21:32Z.
derek: Oh no. That PR was supposed to scope down a wildcard principal but the keystore principal got removed in the filter. My bad.
neha: We couldn't revert immediately because role-boundary prevents devs from editing key policies; only kms-admins can roll keys.
marcos: Temporary mitigation: created a short-lived STS bridge role in the target account and updated a local assume policy so keystore can decrypt. Command I ran: `infractl kms emergency-bridge create --from-account 210987654321 --bridge-role-name bridge-decrypt-sa --ttl 30m`
ops-bot: monitor: warm-pool-sa healthy_nodes: 5 -> 52 (9m).
derek: Recovery looks good. Cost impact: churn + rewarm ~11 GPU-hours; estimate approx USD 2.3k for the incident window.
neha: Compliance gap: audit logs for the emergency bridge creation were delayed because the logshipper rotation job was running and S3 bucket lifecycle temporarily paused. We have a partial audit trail.
compliance-bot: alert: Audit ingestion gap detected for 2026-03-26T21:30-21:40Z. Exception record must include operator justification and manual attestation.
marcos: I filed EXC-SA-2026-98 and attached the bridge creation command + reason. Will follow-up with a retrievable CloudTrail export.
derek: Follow-ups for prevention: (1) Key-policy PR checklist should include an automated test that verifies the keystore principal can assume kms-access-role, (2) gate key-policy merges on simulated decrypt flow from a warm-pool canary, (3) make an operator-scoped path that allows SRE to create emergency bridge roles without full kms-admin perms, with auto-audit and short TTL.
neha: Also recommend we add a CI lint for key-policy PRs that flags any removal of principals matching regex `keystore.*` and require explicit human justification.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: temporary rollback requested for KP-SA-2026-77; kms-admins notified.
marcos: I'll coordinate with kms-admin to fix policy and ensure CloudTrail export is preserved. Filing incident: https://issues.internal/RED-IF-11011 "cross-account key-policy removed keystore assume role -> SA warm-pool decrypt failures and GPU churn".
derek: Apologies everyone. I'm opening PR#453 to reintroduce the scoped keystore principal and adding the simulated assume-role test.
neha: Closing when PR merged, audit export attached, and operator bridge role deleted.
